settings.translation.title: Translation
settings.translation.description: Online translation provider for historical summaries. Only the selected API settings are shown. Credentials are masked and saved in local configuration. Website and API credentials differ.
translation.hint.mymemory: No key required. Anonymous quota: 5000 characters/day. Results are cached by source text.
translation.hint.google: Uses Cloud Translation Basic v2. Enable the API and provide an API key. Website access does not include API usage; account quotas and billing apply.
translation.hint.baidu: Uses the Baidu general translation API. Enter its APP ID and secret, not your Baidu account password.
translation.hint.youdao: Uses Youdao Text Translation with v3 signing. Enter the application ID and secret.
translation.hint.libre: Use a self-hosted endpoint or a hosted instance. The official hosted service requires an API key; self-hosted requirements depend on deployment.
translation.credentials_required: Enter the required application ID / API key for {provider}.
translation.request_failed: {provider} request failed ({code}). Check settings and quota.
translation.unsupported_language: Unsupported language code. Use a standard code mapped by the translation module.
translation.failure.unsupported_pair: {provider} does not support this language pair ({code}). Choose another language or provider.
translation.failure.authentication: {provider} authentication or permission failed ({code}). Check credentials and account access.
translation.failure.quota: {provider} quota or rate limit reached ({code}). Retry later or check your quota.
translation.failure.timeout: {provider} timed out ({code}). Check the network before retrying.
translation.failure.invalid_response: {provider} returned an invalid translation ({code}). The result was not cached.
translation.failure.request_failed: {provider} translation failed ({code}). Check the network, endpoint and language support.
settings.translation.max_workers_hint: Default: 10. Range: 1–10. Native batches count as requests; lower this value if rate limited.
